svg.aria-label: Frontier engineering team — an autonomous software factory on AWS
svg.title: Frontier engineering team — an autonomous software factory on AWS
svg.text: Frontier engineering team — an autonomous software factory on AWS
Humans set intent and boundaries; Kiro Crew and headless Kiro CLI agents build, verify, ship and fix. Automated gates replace per-change approval; only irreversible actions stay human-gated

g.data-tip: Humans write intent: a spec with testable acceptance criteria, a budget, and the boundary the work must stay inside.

g.title: 1. Humans write intent: a spec with testable acceptance criteria, a budget, and the boundary the work must stay inside.

g.data-tip: The Crew conductor decomposes the spec and dispatches headless Kiro CLI workers, one isolated worktree each.

g.title: 2. The Crew conductor decomposes the spec and dispatches headless Kiro CLI workers, one isolated worktree each.

g.data-tip: Workers self-verify locally, then open a pull request; CodeBuild runs the verification mesh: tests, property-based tests, mutation score, SAST, secret scan, cost diff.

g.title: 3. Workers self-verify locally, then open a pull request; CodeBuild runs the verification mesh: tests, property-based tests, mutation score, SAST, secret scan, cost diff.

g.data-tip: When every automated gate and an independent AI review pass, the merge queue merges without a human click.

g.title: 4. When every automated gate and an independent AI review pass, the merge queue merges without a human click.

g.data-tip: Progressive delivery behind a feature flag with automatic rollback on SLO alarms.

g.title: 5. Progressive delivery behind a feature flag with automatic rollback on SLO alarms.

g.data-tip: SLOs, traces and business metrics decide whether the change stays.

g.title: 6. SLOs, traces and business metrics decide whether the change stays.

g.data-tip: On a regression the pipeline rolls back first; DevOps Agent's root cause is written to the work ledger as a new fix task, which the Crew conductor picks up.

g.title: 7. On a regression the pipeline rolls back first; DevOps Agent's root cause is written to the work ledger as a new fix task, which the Crew conductor picks up.
